summary: Iter 71 — Verified end-to-end the new FreeBuild autonomy pipeline (Multi-Deploy + Silent Supervisor + Honesty Wrapper + Escalation Bridge + project_status footer). 22/22 unit tests pass. Live SSE stream on /api/freebuild-chat/project/{pid}/agent-chat-stream emits all three new events in order (honesty_check → escalation → project_status → done). Owner notifications API persists ai_escalation entries with correct Arabic title/message. UI loads FreeBuildChat for the test project and confirms file-upload input + textarea + Honesty Mandate refusal text appearing in the persisted chat history.

minor.issue: Legacy entries (pre-Jan-2026 api_timeout records) use the old schema {category, summary, ts, created_at:<float>} instead of the new {type, title, message, created_at:<ISO>}. UI may render them with empty title. New ai_escalation entries use the correct schema.

This non-streaming endpoint requires multipart/form-data (message=Form(...), files=File(...)). Sending application/json returns 422 'Field required'. Documented here so the next agent doesn't waste a turn — for SSE + honesty/escalation testing always use /agent-chat-stream.

After page reload the card disappears even though the assistant message is persisted. Users lose the 4 deploy buttons unless they trigger another chat turn. Consider persisting project_status events into message.steps[] in DB.

GOOD: project_status event includes pages_substantive (>800 chars) — honest reflection of empty/weak pages instead of just count.

GOOD: Honesty wrapper triggered cleanly on the test message — AI text included Honesty Mandate refusal AND backend marked verified=false, AND escalation landed in DB. Full pipeline integrity confirmed.

context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) Always use /agent-chat-stream (multipart Form) for SSE event testing — NOT /chat (also Form, returns plain JSON). 2) SSE timing: a no-tool 'echo' message takes ~30-60s; tool-using turns take 60-180s. Cloudflare 502s after ~100s on the preview URL — hit http://localhost:8001 directly. 3) The smoke project (49da1e1a-...) is still in discovery phase; if next agent wants to test the project_status footer rendering live, click 'تخطي المستشار' or run /discovery/init first to advance to chat. 4) /api/owner/notifications already has the test escalation row — feel free to filter by project_id to find it. 5) Honesty wrapper is intentionally aggressive: even ASKING the AI to recite a completion sentence triggers a violation (because it has no test_page/verify_my_work evidence). This is BY DESIGN.
rca_of_the_issue: Not a bug — full success. The Honesty Wrapper pipeline (claims_completion → verification_evidence → honesty_check event → should_escalate → create_escalation → owner_notifications + Resend email) is wired end-to-end. The AI even surfaced 'قاعدة #8: Verified Honesty Mandate' in its system response, confirming the honesty nudge from the previous turn is being injected back into the next turn's system prompt as designed.
